title: EOS machine test-run summary
description: The RESULT half of traceability. docs/trace-matrix.md records the human decision "AC1.1 is proven by this test"; this file records that the test actually ran, against which tree, and what it returned. A hand-written ✅ in Markdown is a claim, not a result — EOS reads both and requires them to agree. Emit it from your runner (a reporter, a jq filter over the runner's own JSON, or a small script); it is deliberately framework-neutral.

runId.description: Identifier of the execution (CI run id, local timestamp+host, container id …).

producer.description: WHO produced this evidence. A summary written by hand and one emitted by a verified CI run are both JSON; only this field distinguishes them. `local` is honest and usable for development — a project policy may still refuse to RELEASE on it.

runRef.description: CI run id / URL, when type is ci.

commandDigest.description: SHA-256 of the exact command line that produced this. Binds the result to how it was obtained, so swapping `npm test` for `true` is visible.

toolchainDigest.description: SHA-256 over the resolved toolchain identity (runtime + versions). Optional; when present a toolchain change invalidates the result.

attestation.description: Provenance from an external authority. EOS Core defines the shape and verifies nothing itself: `none` is the honest default, and a provider adapter (github/sigstore/slsa) is what turns a reference into a verified fact. An unavailable provider is BLOCKED, never PASS.

command.description: The command that produced this file. Recorded so a reviewer can reproduce it.

productTree.description: Digest of the tree the tests ran against (`eos product-tree --json`). When present EOS requires it to equal the current tree, so a summary produced before the source changed cannot certify it.

testPath.description: Repository-relative path of the test file. EOS checks that it exists.

selector.description: Test name / node id / fully-qualified method inside the file. EOS checks that the file mentions it when it can.
